68 ( F) ASSISTANCE FOR DELIVERY /  MISCARRIAGE OF PREGNANCY / 
TERMINATION  
OF PREGNANCY TO  FEMALE DIFFERENTLY ABLED PERSON 
 
 
1. 
Gist of the Scheme 
A sum of Rs.6,000/- @ Rs.1,000/- per month for delivery 
and Rs.3,000 for  miscarriage / termination  of  pregnancy 
is  given  to female differently abled person 
2. 
Eligibility Criteria 
Differently  abled  person  holding  identity  card  issued  
by  the welfare board for the differently abled. 
3. 
Whether the prescribed 
application form is 
available 
Yes. Available with District Differently Abled Welfare 
Office. 
4. 
Certificates to be furnished 
Identity card issued by the welfare board for the 
differently abled and medical certificate issued by 
competent authority. 
5. 
Officer to 
whom 
the 
application is to be 
submitted 
District Differently Abled Welfare Officer 
6. 
Grievances if any to be 
addressed to 
Assistant Director (DAW), 
O/o. The Commissionerate  for Welfare of the  Differently 
abled, 
No.5, Kamarajar salai, 
Chennai – 600 005.  
Ph: 044-28444940
